# IJELS - International Journal of English Literature and Social Sciences

> > A peer-reviewed open-access academic journal publishing original research in English literature and social sciences with international indexing and double-blind review standards.

IJELS is an international scholarly journal dedicated to publishing high-quality research articles, reviews, and studies in English literature and social sciences. The journal maintains rigorous peer-review standards and is indexed across multiple academic databases including CrossRef, Index Copernicus, and WorldCat.
